items.title: No step-level data on where contacts are lost
items.whyItMatters: The program knows only the overall 71 percent.
items.opportunity: Measure each cascade step from the monthly extract and map two weeks of cases by hand.

items.title: Missing dates in the system
items.whyItMatters: System data can understate completion by several points (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Add a missing-date check and a data dictionary before freezing the baseline.

items.title: Hardest-to-reach contacts may lose out
items.whyItMatters: Home-based changes may help housed contacts and miss people in shelters or needing interpreters (claim c5).
items.opportunity: Report completion separately for shelter, shift-working and interpreter-needing contacts, and book interpreters for every step.

items.title: Nurse time per contact may rise
items.opportunity: Track nurse hours per case as a balancing measure.

errorsFound: The two undated program reports cannot be rated; their figures are kept as unrated information, not planning values.
reevaluation: The gaps confirm a Lean redesign with step-level measurement, a data quality check and equity reporting.
summary: Four gaps; step-level data, data quality and equity are high severity.
